nodes.description: Public pure function recover(bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature) returning address; validates signature length, s-range and v value, then calls ecrecover.
External pure function toEthSignedMessageHash(bytes32 hash) that prefixes the hash with the Ethereum Signed Message prefix and returns keccak256.
Parameter hash of function recover: the 32-byte digest that is passed into ecrecover.
Parameter signature of function recover: 65-byte packed r,s,v signature read via inline assembly.
Local bytes32 r extracted from the signature at offset 0x20 by the assembly block and forwarded to ecrecover.
Local bytes32 s extracted from the signature at offset 0x40 and forwarded to ecrecover after passing the lower-half-order check.
Local uint8 v extracted as the first byte at offset 0x60 of the signature and forwarded to ecrecover.
Low-level ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) call; returns address(0) on failure and is subject to signature malleability if the s/v checks are bypassed.
Inline assembly block performing mload on the signature bytes pointer for r, s and v; memory reads are unchecked and can silently return garbage for malformed input.
Parameter hash of function toEthSignedMessageHash: the digest that gets prefixed and hashed with keccak256.

edges.reason: Parameter hash is supplied to function recover and consumed by its validation and return logic.
Parameter signature is supplied to function recover and its length is checked before further processing.
Parameter hash flows into toEthSignedMessageHash where it is abi.encodePacked'ed and hashed.
The signature bytes are read by the inline assembly mload block to derive r, s and v.
Assembly assigns v from byte(0, mload(add(signature,0x60))).
Parameter hash is passed as the first argument of the ecrecover call.
Local r is passed to ecrecover as the signature r component.
Local s is passed to ecrecover as the signature s component after the malleability range check.
Local v is passed to ecrecover as the recovery id after the 27/28 check.
Function recover executes the inline assembly extraction block as part of its body.
Function recover reaches the ecrecover call only after the length, s-range and v checks pass.
